messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — PR <https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/8281|#8281> (kv-cache: avoid double-read on warmup) is blocking the midnight cutover at 18:00 UTC. We need one more reviewer/approve. Current approver is kevin but we need a second explicit approval before the cutoff.
kevin: On it, will review in ~20m. tests passed on my laptop but e2e cloud is flaky (timeout on shard 3).
sasha: I can take a quick look — ping me the specific areas you want sanity-checked.
maria: Thanks! main concern is the cache regen path + tiny perf regression on 1k context. Look at the cache invalidation in cache_manager.cc and the added metrics change.
sasha: Saw it, small nit in comments and one potential race on the async callback. Leaving a single-line suggestion in the PR.
maria: Added a follow-up commit that addresses that race and included a short unit test.
jordan: Heads-up: if this hits weird flakiness we should hold the roll and fallback to rc-2 variant. No automatic rollback plan yet.
kevin: Reviewing the new commit now. Quick note: the unit test is fine but I want a second e2e run in CI before approving. If CI is green I'll approve -> merge.
sasha: CI looks green for the latest run (e2e pass). I approve. :thumbsup:
kevin: Approved as well. :+1:
maria: Awesome, thank you both. I'll queue the merge just before the 18:00 UTC window and monitor metrics for the next 30m.
release-bot: Deploy freeze window starts 18:00 UTC. Reminder: merges will auto-block after freeze unless manually overridden by release lead.
jordan: Thanks — maria, hold manual merge if any post-merge alerts show up. If everything is nominal after 30m, ship it.
maria: Will do. merging in 3m. backchannel on pager if anything spikes. :rocket:
